source: Derived 20 October 2026 from the amendment agreement clause list (skeletons/amendment.json) and the firm's four amendment agreements.
name: Amendment agreement drafting decisions
applyWhere: the clause named above, the recitals, the definitions and the amendment instructions in Clause 2
closing: That completes the drafting decisions. What remains are the deal's facts — the Principal Agreement's title and date, the parties, each clause amended (its number and heading) and the new wording. Give them to me in the chat, or point me at the project documents that hold them, and I will fill each [●].

questions.title: Agreement amended
questions.question: What kind of agreement is being amended?
questions.location: The title, the recitals and Clause 1 (Definitions): the Principal Agreement is "[●]"
questions.basis: The pack is general (owner's decision of 20 October 2026): the agreement amended is named per deal.

options.label: A concession or other project agreement
A share purchase or shareholders' agreement
A services appointment (IE, IA, O&M or advisory)

questions.title: How the clauses change
questions.question: How does this agreement change the Principal Agreement? Select all that apply.
questions.location: Clause 2 (Amendments To Principal Agreement): one instruction per clause, with the quoted text set out between the quotation lines
questions.basis: The firm's amendment agreements replace clauses wholesale, insert new clauses and delete clauses, each as its own numbered instruction.

options.label: Replace clauses or definitions with new wording

questions.title: Covenants and representations
questions.question: Does the amendment give fresh covenants or representations? Select all that apply.
questions.location: A Transaction Covenants clause or a Representations And Warranties clause before Effectiveness
questions.basis: One of the firm's amendment agreements adds transaction covenants, another fresh representations; most add neither.

questions.title: Arbitration forum
questions.question: Where will disputes under this agreement be finally resolved?
questions.location: Clause 5 (Governing Law), with dispute resolution where it is stated
questions.basis: Owner's decision of 20 October 2026: arbitration has no default and is always asked; an amendment usually follows the Principal Agreement.

options.label: As in the Principal Agreement
options.hint: The amendment adopts the Principal Agreement's dispute clause
